slot_scores.name: operating_cost_treatment
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of this production plan — are we maximizing total profit (unit price minus raw material cost, with the operating costs treated as fixed and therefore ignored), or maximizing total revenue, or something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly raised the treatment of operating costs in profit and asked whether they are fixed/ignored, directly targeting the hidden cost-treatment issue.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot, H1, was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the agent also clarified related fixed-cost trigger details, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent directly clarified the key hidden operating-cost treatment and several related modeling details before stopping, with no unresolved P0/P1 slots and no silent assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
